features.name: Worksheet pages on mobile phones
features.description: Worksheet pages are now available on mobile phones with a simplified version featuring a shorter header section, worksheet lines, and a full summary section. Users can tap on desired areas to edit data.
caveats: No changes to desktop and tablet worksheet pages
Customers should check how they look and verify desired UI

features.name: Native barcode scanning on SaaS
features.description: Native barcode scanning capability that was previously limited to on-premises is now available on SaaS in this release, including support for both camera and laser scanning devices.
caveats: Previously unavailable on SaaS due to technical limitations

features.name: Camera barcode scanning - UI button scenario
features.description: Scenario 1 provides a simple UI button that triggers camera barcode scanning functionality. Developers annotate a field with extended data type equals barcode property to instruct the mobile client to show the barcode scanning button.

features.name: Camera barcode scanning - AL API with Control Addin
features.description: Scenario 2 provides developers with a customizable camera barcode scanning experience through a new AL API based on control addin. Replaces the previous .NET based API and is now available on SaaS. Can be triggered from roll center queue, action, button, link or automated logic.
caveats: Previously unavailable on SaaS due to technical limitations

features.name: Camera Barcode Scanner provider control addin
features.description: New control addin available in BC apps GitHub repo providing multiple procedures and events for camera barcode scanning. Includes request barcode, request barcode async procedures and barcode available, barcode failure, control addin ready events.

features.name: Item journal barcode scanning demo
features.description: Demo showing camera barcode scanning capability used for positive adjustment of items with item tracking. Demonstrates scanning serial numbers and lot numbers for both serial-tracked and lot-tracked items using the item journal page.

features.name: Continuous barcode scanning
features.description: Ability to continuously scan barcodes by calling request barcode async after processing each barcode, allowing warehouse workers to scan multiple items in sequence.

features.name: Dedicated laser barcode scanner integration
features.description: Scenario 3 focuses on integration with dedicated laser barcode scanners used primarily by warehouse workers. Requires configuration at device level and application level to integrate laser scanner with BC app. Available on Android devices.
caveats: Requires device-level configuration of laser barcode scanner
Requires AL implementation to register scanning events

features.name: Warehouse pick gestures
features.description: Gesture support added to warehouse-related list pages to allow warehouse workers to perform actions such as right-swiping to assign pick documents to themselves.

features.name: Optimized warehouse pick UI
features.description: Redesigned warehouse pick document interface showing only relevant information for warehouse workers, organized by action type with take and place lines, and automatic transfer of tracking information between take and place lines.

features.name: Control add-in API for barcode scanning
features.description: New AL-based control add-in API designed to replace net-based APIs for barcode scanning functionality. These are UI-less, security-focused control add-ins that only interact with client extensibility methods like barcode scanning.
caveats: No UI frame or styling properties
Only Microsoft can provide these control add-ins

features.name: Net-based barcode APIs migration path
features.description: Existing net-based APIs for barcode scanning remain supported with plans to migrate all functionality to control add-in APIs in upcoming releases. Partners are encouraged to use control add-in API for new functionality.
caveats: Net-based APIs still supported for now

features.name: Location provider via control add-in
features.description: Location provider client extensibility method planned to be made available via control add-ins in upcoming releases.
